## Activity

During March 2022, Market Eye Clinic recorded 398 photographic captures. This represents the activity reported for the month and provides the basis for the image quality and grading measures below. The recorded volume should be reviewed alongside the number of images subsequently assessed as suitable or unsuitable for grading.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 15 were marked ungradable. The ungradable rate was 3.8. This measure identifies images that could not proceed through the grading process and should continue to be monitored as part of routine site operations. Any recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be tracked and addressed through the appropriate operational process.

## Grading

A total of 85 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 17 days. This indicates the midpoint of the recorded waiting times for grading during the reporting period. Activity, image quality, and grading performance should be considered together when reviewing the clinic’s monthly service delivery. The site should continue to record operational issues consistently and use routine reporting to identify any changes in image quality or grading turnaround.
